description: Search the shop catalogue. Give words (query), a category, a maximum price in cents or only products in stock. Returns up to 8 products (id, name, price_formatted, available, summary, options such as colour or size) and answer_kind: exact (they match), relaxed or related (NOT exact: only the closest, say so), shop (a question about the shop, see shop_answer) or none (nothing matches: say so, never offer unrelated products).

category_id.description: Only products of this category (see list_categories)

in_stock_only.description: true: only products that can be bought now

limit.description: How many products to return, from 1 to 8

query.description: What to look for: the customer's words or, for a vague need, a product type or synonym of your own that fits

session_id.description: Only if your client does not keep the MCP session (the Mcp-Session-Id header): the session_id that an earlier answer of this server gave you. It keeps the same cart between calls.

name: search_products
